ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... Folder 4 holds the eye chart. ... Folder 6 holds the stomach chart. ... Folder 9 holds the tongue chart. ... Which folder holds the chart on the body part that tastes food?" -> answer org 9; the alt prompt asks about the eye (bridge alt), its 3rd statement. Possible answers after the patch: 4 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 6 (answer at the same statement slot), 8 (the alt prompt's own answer), 9 (answer org kept).
